headline: No date confirmed yet for the coming weekend
detail: Apps Court Farm's car boot page currently carries the banner "THE CAR BOOT IS OPEN THIS SUNDAY". We read that on the evening of Sunday 6 September, so on its face it refers to Sunday 6 September itself, a date that has now passed: the sale closes at 1pm. The farm posts its dates weekly and has not yet put up a notice for Sunday 13 September, so we are not treating any specific future date as confirmed. There is no postponement or cancellation notice on the page. The farm states its car boot sales run "every Sunday from early March, through to the Autumn" and on Bank Holiday Mondays, weather permitting, but it does not publish a fixed calendar. Check the banner on the official page or call 01932 244 822 for the recorded status before travelling.
